steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production inventory equipment icon for the FEET slot of the dark fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk.
Primary request: a pair of ordinary adult human BARE FEET in a quiet, stable standing posture. Exactly two feet, each with five anatomically correct toes; both heels and forefeet bear weight on the same implied level plane. Short upright lower shins and ankles only, no knees or full person. Modest three-quarter view from slightly above and in front, both feet clearly separated by a small transparent gap, one foot set just slightly behind the other. Relaxed toes point mostly toward the viewer, with a slight natural outward angle. This is the neutral unequipped FEET item, not an attack: absolutely no raised foot, no forward kick, no visible sole thrust toward the viewer, no motion streaks.
Composition: square 1024 by 1024, compact centered pair as a single readable icon, about 8 percent empty margin on all sides. Natural body proportions. Upper ends of the short shins dissolve gently into transparency in a painterly manner without exposing cross sections; no severed-limb appearance. No trousers, boots, sandals, socks, straps, bandages or jewelry. Small traces of travel dust on normal warm grey-brown skin, no wounds or blood.
Art direction: dark gothic fantasy with strong sculptural volume, dry-brush painted texture, selective detail, deep charcoal-brown creases, muted warm skin and restrained bone-ivory highlights. Directional warm light comes from the upper left/front left, shadow on the right. Tactile weathered fantasy illustration; neither photorealistic photography nor a glossy 3D render, no cartoon or flat vector. Simple strong silhouette readable at 40–56 pixels.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, alpha zero outside the pair and between the feet. The standing plane is only implied by the posture; do not draw a floor, ground, platform or cast shadow. Skin remains opaque, with clean edges. No black background, checkerboard, halo, colored rectangle, scenery, frame, UI, numbers, letters, labels or watermark. Output ONE finished asset, not a sheet.
